binary_qualification: 670 binary identified by authenticated archived producer manifest only; executable/Cargo.lock absent, neither independently rehashed. Historical c446 source, not current-source performance.

native_printer_binding.format: %12.3e molality and activity, four significant digits
native_printer_binding.interval_rule: x +/- 0.5*10^(adjusted(x)-3), conservative at decade boundaries; native censor >1e-9, omitted species not proved zero.

cases.original_forecast: Under a dominant 1:1 FeSCN model, the complex-specific response should peak near the equal-mole mixture, not at the largest iron input.

original_criteria.criterion: Compare complex-specific concentrations or baseline-corrected spectral features, not total colour intensity.
The sum of analytical Fe and SCN is constant across all three samples.

original_limitations: Three points only bracket a maximum; multiple complexes, hydrolysis and unequal free-ion spectra can invalidate a simple Job interpretation.

# PQ-002: Use continuous variation to test complex stoichiometry
# Design only: predictions below are not measured observations.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 HCl 0.001mol
add v1 FeCl3 0.000025mol
add v1 KSCN 0.000075mol
new
add v2 water 100mL
add v2 HCl 0.001mol
add v2 FeCl3 0.00005mol
add v2 KSCN 0.00005mol
new
add v3 water 100mL
add v3 HCl 0.001mol
add v3 FeCl3 0.000075mol
add v3 KSCN 0.000025mol
measure v1 uvvis
measure v2 uvvis
measure v3 uvvis
inspect

cases.scope: Conditional native analytical comparison only. All original oxide/spectral/speciation warnings remain. No complete physical phase equilibrium, empirical Job stoichiometry, optical response, pH-matched causal comparison, calibrated temperature dependence or rate is inferred.

cases.original_forecast: Phosphate may decrease the Fe–SCN fraction through competing aqueous or solid species; the extra-acid arm helps reveal whether acidity alone explains the response.

original_criteria.criterion: Identify where iron goes when the Fe–SCN response changes.
Do not claim ligand competition solely from unequal pH or a weaker colour.

original_limitations: The acid arm is not automatically pH-matched; interpretation requires solved pH and species. Fe–SCN support remains uncertain.

register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 HCl 0.001mol
add v1 FeCl3 0.0001mol
add v1 KSCN 0.0005mol
new
decant v1 v2 0.5
add v1 H3PO4 0.001mol
add v2 HCl 0.001mol
measure v1 ph
measure v2 ph
measure v1 uvvis
measure v2 uvvis
inspect
